question: Which traditional dance of Tamil Nadu is performed by women dancing in a circle while clapping their hands to a rhythm?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kummi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Kummi** is a traditional folk dance of **Tamil Nadu** performed exclusively by women. It is one of the most ancient forms of folk dances in India.
 
• The dance is performed in a **circle**, where women clap their hands rhythmically while moving to the beat of the music.
 
• The word "Kummi" is derived from the Tamil word "Kommai," which means **clapping hands**. The clapping forms the core rhythm of the dance.
